note: CH-5 (Dart, extraction precision): quokka_android/lib/core/http/api_client.dart builds a one-off client `final fresh = Dio(BaseOptions(..))..interceptors.add(..)` and calls `fresh.post('/auth/refresh', ..)`. `fresh` does not match the client-receiver name heuristic, so the text scan minted a server ROUTE `POST /auth/refresh` and no ENDPOINT; quokka_web's endpoint then paired with that phantom route. A receiver the file binds to a Dio (a `Dio(..)` construction, cascade or not, in a `final` / `var` / typed local, a field or getter declared `Dio`) is a Dio client: its verb calls are ENDPOINTs and never ROUTEs. The base here is a host-only literal (root path), so the endpoint fold adds no prefix. A shelf `Router()` in the same file still registers a ROUTE.
